searchText: happy with source based so no push back as feels more correct, reservoir based I prefer from testing aspect as having one source for all refunds is simpler From impl side, either case is fine. I lean on returning it in reservoir, but it is weak opinion, source base is fine too. In the current spec, we reset the reservoir back to its initial value on exceptional halt. What it does under the hood is: calculate the spilled amount into the regular, burn it alongside other regular if spill is non-zero. What it does is essentially source-based. IMO, if we want to do this, source-based mechanism is better.

excerpts.author: garyrong
excerpts.content:
In the current spec, we reset the reservoir back to its initial value on exceptional halt. What it does under the hood is: calculate the spilled amount into the regular, burn it alongside other regular if spill is non-zero. 

What it does is essentially source-based.

IMO, if we want to do this, source-based mechanism is better.
